reconciliation.message: Box-score reconciliation in progress — awaiting manual box-score uploads.
reconciliation.details: Some player box scores are incomplete. Career-total changes do not isolate the missing games, so gaps have not been estimated. Grades and adjusted overalls are provisional and use available active-game data only; missing and zero-stat appearances are excluded.

gradingBenchmarks.source: ChelHead visible Overall breakdown: average 3v3 center, wing, defenseman and human goalie
gradingBenchmarks.limitations: Rounded model reference averages from ChelHead tracked population; cohort count and standard deviations not published in these panels. Model uses per-game rates/shrinkage; our partial UI boxscores lack exact TOI, so grade uses observed appearances without guessing DNF durations. This is a coaching calibration, not a reconstructed official ChelHead model.
